name: Planet Jumping
description: Single-page immersive space portal: preloader with a percentage counter, a canvas scene, planet background videos and a custom orbit cursor. No scrolling.

palette.accent: carried by the planetary video imagery rather than a flat hex

typography.display: system geometric sans (SF Pro / Aalto lineage), very large planet names
typography.body: system UI stack - deliberately no webfonts

layout: canvas scene as the persistent backdrop
motion: custom cursor: orbit ring + dot + label
voice: immersive and editorial - short labels and captions sitting over cinematic visuals
